text:
Maria: Quick sync — proposing final v2 deprecation timeline so owners can lock windows. Announce 2025-06-10, canary 2025-06-24, global cutover 2025-07-15. Any blockers?

Aj: I can own the SDK work (redwood-sdk-js). Targeting rc.1 next week. PR: #4523. Need docs to land before we publish the RC.

Kevin: eng-runtime note: KV cache change needs a tiny shim for v2 token routing, planning to land by 2025-06-18. I'll add a perf/regression test called kv-shim-smoke.

Sam: eng-platform: routing fallback flag exists but migration graph is stale. Who owns the migration graph update?

Maria: @Sam please map the graph ownership to @Jin for telemetry + graph updates. Jin, you good?

Jin: I can take telemetry + rollout graph update. Will add a canary metric v2_migration_success_rate to infra. Need a small schema tweak and one PR. ETA 6/13.

Lisa: Docs: I can finish the migration guide by 2025-06-12, will fold in Aj's SDK notes and a short upgrade checklist.

Aj: thanks @Lisa. Also asking for an SDK API compat test in CI — can someone add a job, name it sdk-compat-v2. Simple smoke: call common endpoints and verify response shapes.

Kevin: I'll add a smoke CI job and a nightly compat run. Need a canonical test corpus though. @Maria can you drop the prompt set?

Maria: I'll upload the migration prompt set to repos/migration/tests by EOD. It will include ~25 representative cases.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2025-06-24 00:00 UTC. Notifying owners: Aj, Jin, Kevin.

Sam: Quick ops question — do canaries require explicit SLO rollback hooks? We have auto-fallback already but need a runbook. @Oncall-Bot?

Oncall-Bot: FYI: if error rate > 2% during canary, auto-fallback will trigger to v1.ops-route. Manual rollback steps are documented in /runbooks/canary-rollback.

Maria: Recap / owners: Aj -> SDK RC + PR (#4523), Jin -> telemetry + graph, Kevin -> shim + CI, Lisa -> docs. I'll send the customer-facing notice after SDK RC. Ping here if anything slips. :thumbsup:

Aj: I'll post the RC tag and CI run link when green.

Kevin: pinging infra for extra capacity on 2025-06-24 canary window.

Jin: will open the telemetry PR tomorrow AM and tag reviewers.

Lisa: adding a short upgrade checklist to docs repo and linking to PRs.

Maria: thanks all — let's keep async updates here. If anyone needs to reassign, mention me.
